_readme: Octopus model registry + routing rules. Re-read on every request - edit and save, no restart needed.
models[]: one entry per model Octopus may use. 'provider' picks the code that talks to it:
claude_code = the agent lane (runs `claude -p` inside the project folder; set 'model' to pass --model),
openai      = OpenAI Responses API (needs OPENAI_API_KEY in the launchd plist),
gemini      = Google Gemini API (needs GEMINI_API_KEY in the launchd plist).
Set 'enabled': false to take a model out of rotation without deleting it.
coding/reasoning are rough 1-5 ratings, cost/speed are relative 1-5 (5 = most expensive / fastest).
price_per_mtok (USD per million tokens) is only used to estimate cost - check current prices before trusting it.
routing.categories: for each task category, 'candidates' is the preference order - the first one that is
enabled and not rate-limited wins, the rest are fallbacks. 'transferable': false means never fall back just
because the first choice is rate-limited - wait for it instead (coding work shouldn't hop models mid-project).
octopus-tools (provider 'tools') is the personal assistant: email, calendar and reminders through connected accounts.
It is not a language model. routing.assistant_planner lists the models it may use, in order, when a request needs interpreting; through its 'ai' tool it can also hand work to any other model here
(same candidates, availability and cost limits as the Ask box - assistant/tools/ai.py) -
claude-code last means it only falls back to your Claude subscription (with every tool switched off) when no API-key model is available.
Per model: 'modality': 'image' = makes pictures instead of text. 'scarce': true = a limited resource (a subscription window) the router
avoids spending on work that doesn't need it. 'web_search': true = can ground answers in a live web search. 'rate_limit' is a free-text note shown on the AI Providers page.
Per category: 'optimize' = cost | balanced | quality picks how the router weighs price against strength (see octopus/plan.py);
'quality_from' = which rating (coding | reasoning) counts as strength; 'classifiable': false keeps a category out of the classifier's menu
(instant commands about Octopus itself are recognised by rules). routing.weights can override the weight presets.

coding.description: Needs to read or change files in the user's project, run commands, tests or git, deploy, or otherwise act on the codebase.

salesforce.description: Salesforce work in a project: Apex, LWC, metadata, orgs, sf/sfdx commands.

system.description: Working on this Mac itself: disk space, apps, services, settings - not a code project.

writing.description: Producing text where the words are the product: essays, articles, emails written out as text, rewrites, summaries, translations.

research.description: Looking something up on the web or comparing current information, with sources.

image.description: Generate or draw a picture, logo, illustration or other image from a description.

general.description: Writing, explaining, analysing, planning or answering where everything needed is in the message itself - including explaining code that is pasted in.

simple.description: A short factual question, definition, quick rewrite or small talk that a small fast model handles well.

assistant.description: Act on the owner's own email, calendar or reminders: read, search, draft, send or reply to email; read, create, move or cancel calendar events; check availability; set reminders. Also questions about Octopus's own task queue that need more than a status line, and jobs that combine those with a model, such as summarising an email with a named model.

control.description: A command about Octopus itself: what is happening, stop or cancel a task, continue the previous one.

project.description: Project management inside Octopus: list projects, show or add to a project's backlog.

discussion.description: Talking a task through out loud before it is queued (Alexa's "let's discuss a task"). Only reached by picking the Voice Partner agent - quick, cheap models, since every reply is waited for.
